interpretation: LIB printed36-37 describes two straight steel tubes in the central sump trough, a pressure tube feeding the main bearings through vertical branches and a front-sump return tube. Aircraft configuration transfer remains conditional.
The catalogue has one large and six small bearing-feed tubes, totaling seven; six small tubes alone must not be mistaken for complete main-bearing coverage.
SNL14 callout27 locates the large tube at the flywheel-end main bearing; exact dimensions and all receiving passages must be checked against saved native geometry.
The current case reserves longitudinal holes at Y+/-19,Z-174,R5.5mm. These are earlier estimates, not source tube dimensions or proof of fluid connectivity.
The two current receiving sockets remain hydraulically unqualified until separate supply/return paths, connections, plug sealing and bearing feeds are modeled and checked.
